annotations.text:
CLUES - one per day, in order. Each is 1080x1920.

01 Something exists, you are not saying what. The redaction is the signature device.
02 AOV / CAC / LTV. An audience filter, not a description.
03 A tension they already feel, answer redacted.

ANSWERS - the payoff, before the reveal.

04 Decodes 02. Lets in the followers who did not know the acronyms.
05 Fills 03's redaction bar with the word: math. Ties both clues together and asks for notifications.

REVEAL - 06.

Opens in story 01's voice ("So - I've been building") and puts the name where the redaction bars were. That callback is the whole payoff.

The body line resolves clue 03 directly: the math IS offer, acquisition, retention, margin.

CTA is a DM keyword, not a link - it starts a conversation you can qualify in, and the footer promises a fit check rather than a pitch.

DM keyword is 10X. Set up an auto-reply for it before this posts.

The empty band above each CTA is deliberate: poll or question sticker on the teasers, link sticker on the reveal if you have a page.

Top and bottom 250px stay clear for Instagram's profile row and reply bar.
